src/workflows.mjs.why: the control flow (create, wait for a signal with a timeout, pay) is the certified machine in ./machine; the module re-exports the governed host

src/worker.mjs.why: the plugin line: sink, signing key, the machine, and trust (or allowUncertified for development)

src/server.mjs.why: JavaScript translation of the same endpoints and transitions (the sample's TypeScript enum needs a build step)

src/clients/approve.mjs.why: startGoverned instead of workflow.start; the approval is a proposal against the open order, by an actor with the human role, instead of a bare signal

src/clients/timeout.mjs.why: startGoverned; the approval window is the machine's timer, not a start argument
